VBO:0201253.summary: Friendly and determined on a scent trail, the Small Jura Hound shares the Swiss Short-Legged Hound’s hunting character. It follows game independently and gives tongue with a melodious cry, including on difficult ground. Smaller hounds were developed for enclosed Swiss hunting grounds around 1900; Jura denotes the black-and-tan color variety.
VBO:0201253.shortDescription: A black-and-tan Swiss hound variety, sharing the breed’s friendly character, independent scent work and melodious cry.

sources.title: Swiss Short-Legged Hound: Official FCI Breed Standard (2015)
sources.evidence: Entire FCI60 specifies friendly calm-to-lively character, steady determined independent scent hunting with melodious cry on difficult terrain and wounded-game tracking; planned smaller-hound development for Swiss enclosed hunting grounds and1905 club. Literal exact color forms, mature rectangle, lean robust short legs/very long low folded ears and natural low full pointed tail support morphology. Shared normative breed character, no color psychology.

sources.title: Swiss Short-Legged Hound: SKG breed portrait, with SNLC (2024)
sources.evidence: Actual entire German body identifies2015 merger of four traditional color forms into one breed, all colors/mixes permitted and interbreeding allowed; around1900 slower short-legged hounds for enclosed hunting, shared independent finding/voicing and tracking work. Medical/lifespan/child-safety and absolute nonaggression claims excluded.

VBO:0201254.summary: Friendly and tireless on the trail in its standard, the Small Lucerne Hound shares the Swiss Short-Legged Hound’s hunting character. It searches independently and announces pursuit with a melodious cry; tracking wounded game is another documented role. Lucerne denotes the blue-speckled, black-mantled color variety within the shared modern breed.
VBO:0201254.shortDescription: A blue-speckled Swiss hound variety, sharing the breed’s friendly character, independent hunting and melodious cry.

VBO:0201255.summary: Friendly and steady on a trail in its standard, the Small Schwyz Hound shares the Swiss Short-Legged Hound’s hunting character. It searches and drives game with a melodious cry, even on difficult terrain, and is also used to track wounded game. Schwyz identifies the white-and-orange color variety within the modern shared breed.
